distributeAll(uint256).details: Fault-tolerant: if a transfer to a single payee fails (e.g. blocklisted on Arc),      that payee's state change is reverted silently and we continue to the next payee,      keeping `release()` as the canonical single-payee fallback.      Bounded by MAX_PAYEES so gas cost is predictable.

MAX_PAYEES().notice: Maximum payees per vault to bound loop gas in distributeAll.

distributeAll(uint256).notice: Releases pending USDC to all payees with a positive balance.
